name: vscode-requirejs
description: Looks up modules and identifiers in AMD projects using RequireJS.

scripts.version: npx conventional-changelog -p angular -i CHANGELOG.md -s && git add CHANGELOG.md

requireModuleSupport.enableDefinitionPro.description: Enables cross-module symbol lookup in the "Go to Definition" command.

requireModuleSupport.enableReferenceProv.description: Enables cross-module symbol lookup in the "Find All References" command.

requireModuleSupport.enableCompletionIte.description: Enables selecting from the module directory content when typing "/" inside a string with a module path.

requireModuleSupport.enableHoverProvider.description: Enables displaying the file-system path, which the module path resolves to, when hovering with the mouse cursor above a string with a module path.

requireModuleSupport.enableRenameProvide.description: Enables cross-module symbol lookup in the "Rename Symbol" command.

requireModuleSupport.showGoToDefinitionM.description: Shows the "Go to Definition Module" command in context menus.

requireModuleSupport.showRenameExportedS.description: Shows the "Rename Exported Symbol" command in context menus.

requireModuleSupport.configFile.description: Path of the RequireJS configuration file relative to workspace root

requireModuleSupport.enableCjsModules.description: Parse source files as pure CommonJS modules

requireModuleSupport.enableJsxModules.description: Enable support for the JSX language extension

requireModuleSupport.enableEsModules.description: Enable detection of ES modules in addition to AMD or CJS modules

requireModuleSupport.moduleCacheSize.description: Maximum count of parsed modules and their dependencies kept in memory as cache to improve performance

requireModuleSupport.dynamicModuleCacheS.description: Make cache sizes depend on the count of JavaScript modules in the project
How many percent of the JavaScript module count should be reserved not to exhaust the cache so quickly

requireModuleSupport.includeModulePatter.description: File globbing pattern to find JavaScript modules in this project

requireModuleSupport.excludeModulePatter.description: File globbing pattern to exclude when looking for JavaScript modules in this project

requireModuleSupport.cutFileCompletionEx.description: File extensions to cut, if the file name is offered in module path completion

requireModuleSupport.includeFileCompleti.description: Only the specified file extensions will be included for module path completion; all will be included, if empty

requireModuleSupport.excludeFileCompleti.description: The specified file extensions will not be included for module path completion

requireModuleSupport.modulePath.description: Module path relative to workspace root

requireModuleSupport.onlyNavigateToFile.description: When set to true, it will prevent the final search for the identifier in the landing module and instead just reference the file.

requireModuleSupport.pluginExtensions.description: Assigns default file extensions to target module paths used with RequireJS plugins

requireModuleSupport.moduleProcessingBat.description: How many documents should be opened and searched before cancelling of the operation is possible
